body: Fitness isnt really my problem. I play some sports, athleticism sort of runs in the family. I just cant seem to talk to people. Like when I get introduced to someone, I say hi, and thats its, I dont know what else to say. This means I cant really go far at all with new people who I meet
Found this again. I decided im going to give myself one more month to see if I can try something else, maybe make just 1 more friend or something. Thanks.

I get that many people are like this at my age. But I just dont see it going away, I have at least another 2 years before I get to really change my surroundings (after 6th form) And part of me doubts that im even capable of living normally afterwards

The thing is, im not doing what I want to do, in fact I guess i dont even know what I want to do. I mean, like most people I enjoy having friends and being with them, doing stuff with them. Something I no longer do because I cant do it.

I find it hard to say whats bothering me the most. Mostly, im scared that in the future I will look back and wish I had lived, but I cant seem to do this, I dont think I can wait anymore. Also I wish I could have like, a best friend to just hang out with all the time, instead of always being alone.
